description: Search Daawid's open registry of people, businesses and organizations by what the user needs, such as 'a dentist in Nairobi' or 'a CRM for a small team'. Each result says who it is, where, and whether it takes on work; get_entry shows one to the user, get_entry_sections reads parts of one.

acceptingWork.description: Only entries that state they take on new work now.

language.description: The language the user writes in: "ja". Summaries come in it, when the entry has it.

place.description: A town or district: "Nairobi", "Shibuya, Tokyo", "Paris, Texas".

near.description: The place the user asks about, which they named. Entries there or serving it come first, then the nearest. Never coordinates or a street address.

openAt.description: Only entries open at this moment, by their stated hours: "2026-11-06T18:30:00+01:00". Only when the user asks what is open.

outcome.description: What the user wants to achieve with it, in a few of their words: "keep track of leads in a small team", "fix a leaking tap today". It helps the best fits come up and leaves nobody out. No names or personal details.

query.description: What the user is looking for, in a few words: "carpenter", "fontanero urgente", "CRM". The place goes in `near`, and what they want to achieve in `outcome`.

radiusKm.description: Only within this many km of `near`. Only when the user names a distance; there is no default.

verifiedOnly.description: Only entries whose owner proved control of their website.

name: search
title: Search entries
